name: Kaito
source:
Kaito is the only character who lived in Japan before he became a Roachrist (hence why he has a Japanese name). He is very playful yet pretty lazy and really hates doing work – he’d much prefer to go out and play with his friend Effy. He also really likes ice-cream.

(From [url=http://liemyx.wordpress.com/2011/07/10/kago-no-naka-no-alicis-review/]Liemyx's Eroge Blog[/url])
